annotation.cut_point:
We are given the fraction:

$$
\frac{10}{n}
$$

And we are told that:

$$
\frac{10}{n} = 9 \text{ (the 20 - fifth decimal to the right)}
$$

reflection.error_reason: It incorrectly treats the given decimal digit 9 as the entire value of the fraction 10/n.
reflection.new_direction: Interpret the given 9 as a specific decimal digit of 10/n and use the decimal expansion of 10/n to solve for the required quantity.
